title: Berlin, Germany
subtitle: Bespoke Trip Planning
desc: This Berlin trip was designed around a milestone birthday and a basketball game. When a group of 17 decided to celebrate a 25th birthday in style, the brief was simple: kick off 2026 with a trip nobody would forget, centred on the NBA Europe game between the Orlando Magics and Memphis Grizzlies. I planned the full week as a flexible itinerary, with a shared nine-bedroom Airbnb as home base, day-by-day plans and a clear price list so everyone knew costs upfront. Three of the group had game tickets, so I made sure the rest never felt like they were waiting around: a team gaming session, jazz bars, riverside food stalls, European eateries and plenty of downtime. The result was a trip that worked for basketball fans and non-fans alike.
details:
DATE: January 2026
TRIP TYPE: City Break
GROUP SIZE: 17 People
INCLUDED: Flights, Accommodation, Itinerary, Activities, Transport
review1_text: "Sharleen planned the whole week around the NBA game and somehow made it work for all 17 of us. Everything was clear, from where to stay to what everything would cost. Watching the NBA in Berlin was a dream, and the rest of the week felt just as well thought through."
review2_text: “I didn’t go to the game, but I had an amazing trip anyway. The itinerary kept us busy without feeling rushed. The gaming house and the jazz bar were highlights, and there was still time to relax. The Airbnb was also perfect for all of us"

She’d also left proper gaps for doing nothing, like a long afternoon on the beach and a boat ride out on the water that ended up being a highlight."

title: Marrakech, Morocco
desc:
Marrakech was a birthday trip for three friends, planned for three nights and four days in the height of summer. It also fell over Eid, so a lot of the usual options were closed or limited, and the plan had to be built around the holiday from the start.

The group wanted a proper celebration, but they were nervous about safety and where they’d be staying. So I chose secure, trusted accommodation and arranged air-conditioned private transfers between every stop. That meant no navigating, no waiting in the heat and no uncertainty about getting from A to B.

The itinerary then focused on the best of Marrakech that was still open, leaving time to slow down and experience Morocco's rich culture, alongside the more thrilling experiences they had anticipated.
